messages.text:
The shop’s records show two napkins received back, but not the third, so I can’t refund all three now. Items must be received before they can be refunded. (refund-policy/v2/return)

Your discounted total was **BRL 273.00**, split equally into **BRL 91.00 per napkin**. For identical items, the total is divided by the quantity and rounded down to whole centavos; any leftover centavos are added one at a time to the last units. These shares stay fixed. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Would you like to request **BRL 182.00 for the two received napkins**? Payment would still require your confirmation using the proposal card’s button and staff approval, so I can’t promise completion today. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
